Get to know amazing facts about Weather through Sciene !!
Weather is what’s happening outside—like if it’s sunny, rainy, windy, or snowy. It can change really fast! Did you know lightning is hotter than the sun?.
Snow isn't always white—it can be pink too, because of tiny algae. Weather helps us decide what to wear and when to play outside!
